root.label: Mandiant and SlowMist Bitget investigation reports

events.label: Mandiant and SlowMist Bitget investigation reports

slots.name: investigation report date
slots.sentence: Investigation reports released Sept. 30 by Mandiant, part of Google Cloud, and blockchain security firm SlowMist found that the attackers compromised two third-party security products before gaining access to Bitget’s production wallet systems.

slots.name: earliest malicious activity date
slots.sentence: SlowMist traced the earliest malicious activity in available logs to Aug. 31, when a previously unknown, or zero-day, vulnerability was exploited in one of the products.
